headline: FAA moves to retire floppy disks from air traffic control
summary: The FAA is phasing out floppy disks still used to run critical pieces of US airspace, after Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced an effort to replace them with a new digital system.

claims.statement: The FAA is phasing out floppy disks used in air traffic control.
